changes: Fork test build B6. Nothing of its own. Its updater must be byte-identical to B5's, so the updater leaves itself alone and any leftover .superseded is cleaned up.
Fork test build B5. The updater is built without the commit id for the first time, so it differs from B4 and replaces itself once.
Fork test build B4. Nothing of its own, and the updater is unchanged from B3 on purpose, so this update should skip almost every file and clean up leftovers.
Fork test build B3. The updater itself is different in this one, so the installed updater has to replace itself to take it.
Fork test build B2. Nothing of its own. The new updater does this one, and should delete the old Updater and replace every file once.
Fork test build B1. The old updater should reach this one and unpack TopSpeedUpdater alongside itself.
Rewrote bot driving behavior. Bots learn how to use brakes when necessary, slow down or accelerate based on incoming turns, avoid obstacles, and hard difficulty mode is a serious hard mode now.
Fixed a long-standing bug where when another vehicle crosses the finish line, the player would only hear it's sound and the sound would get cut completely instead of slowing down.
